entities.summary: Clayton Beddoes is a Canadian ice hockey coach and former professional ice hockey centre. He played two seasons in the National Hockey League. He is currently an assistant coach for the Seattle Torrent of the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL), and has coached the Italian national team at two World Championships.
